# Godhans Tree Company

> Veteran-owned and disabled-veteran-owned tree service in Jacksonville, NC, serving all of Onslow County since 2013 — 3,500+ jobs. Tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, 24/7 emergency and storm response. $2M general liability with every machine individually insured; certificates on request. NC does not license tree contractors — we publish real pricing and insurance proof instead. Free estimates, military discount.

## Pricing
- [Tree Removal Cost in North Carolina (2026 Guide)](https://godhans.com/tree-removal-cost-north-carolina): Real ranges: $800 minimum, most jobs $1,500–$3,500; size and access bands; coastal NC and Onslow County sections.
- [Stump Grinding in Jacksonville, NC](https://godhans.com/stump-grinding-jacksonville-nc): $200 minimum, $6/inch at the root flare, 10+ inch grind depth, full excavation from $800.

- [Tree Removal](https://godhans.com/tree-removal-jacksonville-nc): Removal with resistograph decay testing; pine and sweetgum specifics; near-house and tight-access work.
- [Tree Trimming](https://godhans.com/tree-trimming-jacksonville-nc): Structural pruning off rooflines and power lines; oak preservation via epicormic growth.
- [Emergency Tree Service](https://godhans.com/emergency-tree-service-jacksonville-nc): 24/7 response; hazardous tree removal.
- [Storm Cleanup](https://godhans.com/storm-cleanup-jacksonville-nc): Hurricane and storm debris, leaning-tree risk checks.

- [Residential Tree Service](https://godhans.com/residential-tree-service-jacksonville-nc): Homeowner-focused; the $800 minimum explained.
